Hi Lena / AP team,

Following up on invoice INV-7893 (issued 2026-11-12) — outstanding balance is $197,540.00 and the invoice is currently 82 days past due. We understand Polaris has an open question about VAT treatment which is holding the payment, but we need to get a practical plan in place to avoid escalation.

Proposal (to unblock things quickly):
- Immediate remittance of 40% of the outstanding balance ($79,016.00) within 7 business days.
- Remaining 60% held pending receipt of the VAT documentation you outlined (VAT registration confirmation + beneficiary tax certificate).
- Redwood to waive one late fee installment if Polaris commits to the 40% payment by 2027-03-28.

Attached: INV-7893.pdf (invoice), VAT-support-Polaris-2026.zip (copies of prior VAT correspondence), mutual-action-plan-v1.xlsx (proposed milestones & owners).

If Polaris cant meet the 40% today, suggest a short call with your finance lead + our CFO (Marcus) to agree next steps. Were trying to avoid formal credit hold or service impact, but were reaching the point where leadership involvement is required.

Please confirm by EOD Mon 2027-03-22.

Thanks,

Team — quick internal note and proposed path forward. (Forwarding Polaris reply below for context.)

Summary: Polaris will consider partial payment; tax wants contract clause + VAT certificate. They countered with 30% now and 14-day extension on the remainder.

Recommended approach (ops + legal):
1) Accept 30% immediate remittance to signal good faith ($59,262.00) and confirm waiver of one late fee installment.
2) Redwood to provide highlighted contract excerpt showing pricing/tax clause (attached to Polaris). Legal (Markus) to confirm language.
3) Polaris provides VAT certificate within 14 days; if docs arrive, remaining 70% paid within 7 days of validation.
4) If docs not provided in 14 days, escalate to formal credit hold + notify Product & CS.

Risks: precedent for accepting lower partial payments; possible delay in collection if Polaris stretches the dispute. Mitigation: require ACH trace/confirmation and include an explicit dotted-line due date for the balance in the mutual-action-plan spreadsheet.

Action items:
- Markus: quick review and confirm we can share contract excerpt (redact pricing if needed).
- Marcus: approve temporary waiver of late fee and exception to accept 30% (we may need approval from CFO).
- Karthik: prep short notice for CS/Product in case we must enforce credit hold.

If Marcus is OK, Ill send a one-line confirmation to Polaris and attach the contract excerpt.
